description: Paraphrased safety-device and installation guidance from the aroTHERM plus installation manual, used for free-text keyword retrieval when an installer's symptom carries no formal fault code (n8n 'Retrieve Manual Context' node). See README.md for source and copyright notes.

entries.summary: Communication faults between the outdoor unit and its controller are documented as usually a wiring/cable-spec/polarity issue at installation, not a broken unit - check the eBUS wiring before escalating to the manufacturer.
Low or absent circulation flow is documented as usually a blockage, trapped air, or an incorrectly balanced circuit - an installer-side check, before it's treated as a hardware fault.
entries.source: Vaillant aroTHERM fault code reference (F.532 / F.788)

entries.summary: Restricted airflow or excess frost on the outdoor unit is documented as typically caused by debris or a maintenance gap around the evaporator, not a component failure - clear and recheck before escalating.

Refrigerant-circuit pressure exceeding the safety threshold trips a protective cutout after repeated failed restarts - documented as a hardware/refrigerant-circuit issue requiring a certified technician.
entries.source: Vaillant aroTHERM installation manual, section 3.14 (safety devices)
